name: Snickerdoodles (Idaho Daily Statesman)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Stir together sugar and butter until creamy.
Dissolve baking soda in milk, then add.
Add flour, cream of tartar and salt.
Dust the top of the cake with cinnamon and sugar.

culture.text: A snickerdoodle is a type of cookie made with flour, fat, sugar, and salt, and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Other spice-sugar mixes may also be used, such as cardamom sugar or a mixture of cardamom, cinnamon, and allspice. Eggs may also sometimes be used as an ingredient, with cream of tartar and baking soda added to leaven the dough. Snickerdoodles are characterized by a cracked surface and can be either crisp or soft depending on the ingredients used.
